value.rationale: Deletion of a single vertex and recomputation of intrinsic distances is a canonical missing-observation operation. The theorem proves a sharp all-order loss of exactly q independent integral 2-classes, primitive injection, no induced torsion, and explicit integral homotopy in every finite projective plane. It resolves a natural relative stability problem beyond unpunctured Betti counts and is not a numerical finite slice.
